args.query: members of Congress first elected term start year

sql: SELECT congress, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN district IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sen_rows FROM officials.members WHERE congress >= 118 GROUP BY congress ORDER BY congress
